issues.description: The return type of fix_fix2float is inconsistent between the test utilities and the example program. In tests/src/math_fix.h the function is defined to return double (and implemented in the header), while in example_program/src/math_fix.c and example_program/src/math_fix.h the function is declared/implemented to return float. This mismatch can confuse students inspecting the API and may lead to subtle type/promote-related issues when comparing outputs or porting code between the test harness and the example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the fix_fix2float signature across repositories and files. Choose one return type (prefer using float for consistency with the example program, or double everywhere if higher precision is desired), update the prototype in example_program/src/math_fix.h and the implementation in example_program/src/math_fix.c, and modify tests/src/math_fix.h accordingly so all artifacts declare/implement the same return type. Ensure printf/printing helpers use the matching format specifier or cast as needed.
